name: p2psh
description: P2P SSH-over-WebRTC with Nym signaling and ML-KEM key exchange

scripts.test: tsx tests/ml-kem-kat.ts && tsx tests/protocol.ts && tsx tests/connect-string.ts && tsx tests/limits.ts && tsx tests/aead.ts && tsx tests/handshake.ts

_notes.@nymproject/sdk-full-fat: Browser-only: pulled in by vite at web build time and inlined into the static bundle. Not needed at Node runtime (server uses the WS-based NymTransport instead), hence devDependencies. Removing it would still let `npm run server` work but break `npm run web` / `vite build`.
